topic: After God Valley, Garling was promoted to Supreme Commander of the Knights of God, then promoted again to the Five Elders—the system rewarded him instead of punishing him
title: Garling Got Promoted For God Valley
description: Garling orchestrated God Valley. Rocks fell at the island. The World Government declared him the champion. Chapter 1125 shows him decades later: one of the Five Elders, second-highest authority beneath only Imu. He was never punished. He was only promoted.
comment: Did Garling earn his Five Elders seat through strength alone, or through loyalty to the people already in power?

lines.text: After God Valley, Garling was declared the official champion of the entire incident by the World Government itself.

shot.search: Garling declared champion God Valley official
shot.fallback: noble celebrated as an official hero

lines.text: He got promoted to Supreme Commander of the entire Knights of God, commanding every elite knight.
Then he got promoted again. Chapter 1125 shows him as one of the Five Elders, second-highest authority beneath only Imu.

shot.fallback: powerful figure near the very top

lines.text: Nobody ever asked why a man who orchestrated a hundred thousand civilian casualties got promoted instead of punished.

shot.search: System rewards Garling no questions asked
shot.fallback: system knowingly rewarding a cruel decision

lines.text: The answer's simple: Garling was useful to the right people at the right moment.

shot.search: Garling useful to power above him

lines.text: Saturn himself, already a Five Elder, watched God Valley unfold and approved the whole competition personally.

shot.search: Saturn approves Garling God Valley choice
shot.fallback: approval from an even higher authority

lines.text: In a government built on family name and obedience, loyalty to power is the only currency that actually matters.

shot.fallback: system built on hierarchy and obedience

lines.text: Garling learned that lesson perfectly, and the World Government kept promoting him for understanding it best...

shot.fallback: figure who learned the system's true rules

self_check.loop: last line returns to the pattern (Garling learns and gets rewarded) without exact repetition
